newsitem.title: USA: Omnicom Group to buy Fleishman-Hillard.
newsitem.headline: Omnicom Group to buy Fleishman-Hillard.

text.p: Omnicom Group Inc on Wednesday said it signed a letter of intent to acquire Fleishman-Hillard Inc, an employee-owned public relations company formed in 1946, for cash and stock.

New York-based Omnicom said the transaction would create the largest global public relations group, which would include Fleishman-Hillard and its Porter Novelli International unit. Combined sales would reach about $300 million in 1997, Omnicom said.
John Graham, chairman and chief executive officer of Fleishman-Hillard, also will serve as chairman and CEO of the new group, reporting to John Wren, president and chief executive officer of Omnicom.
Robert Druckenmiller, president and CEO of Porter Novelli, will become president of the newly formed group.
Financial terms were not disclosed. Earlier, sources familiar with the pending transaction valued the deal between $85 million and $100 million.
Ketchum Public Relations Worldwide, which was purchased by Omnicom in 1996, will operate as a separate agency outside the group.
Omnicom Group is a large communications and advertising company, which includes the ad agencies BBDO Worldwide; DDB Needham Worldwide and TBWA Chiat/Day.
